note: CardPack reworked to two-step commit/reveal. commitPack() pays and reserves but chooses no cards; revealPack() mints from a FUTURE block's hash fixed at commit time, so a contract receiver can no longer read the pull and revert to re-roll for free (H-8). Seed is deterministic once committed, so a reverting receiver only fails its own reveal and gets identical cards on retry. UNCOMPILED (forge not installed).

Randomness no longer relies on block.prevrandao (a constant on Arbitrum Orbit). revealPack mixes blockhash(commitBlock+1) — unknown to the buyer at commit time — with an operator-maintained operatorSeed beacon. revealPack is the single hook a Chainlink VRF would plug into. UNCOMPILED.

setTimeouts now bounded (funding <= 24h, settle <= 7d). Each Match snapshots fundingTimeout/settleTimeout at createMatch and reclaim reads the match's snapshots, so a later admin setTimeouts cannot retroactively lock an open match (H-10). UNCOMPILED.
Added uint16 rakeBps to the Match struct, snapshotted from the live rakeBps in createMatch; settle() uses m.rakeBps. A later setRake cannot change the rake an open match pays. UNCOMPILED.

Added a 1h RECLAIM_GRACE after settleTimeout that is exclusive to the operator: permissionless reclaim of a Funded match is valid only at fundedAt + settleTimeout + RECLAIM_GRACE, so a losing player can no longer front-run settle with reclaim. UNCOMPILED.

nonReentrant added to deposit, settle, settleDraw, cancelMatch and reclaim (claim already had it). ReentrancyGuard's shared flag means a hook-bearing token cannot cross-re-enter any path during deposit's transfer (H-11). CEI preserved; settleDraw is the explicit draw/void path. UNCOMPILED.

MasterToken.mint now capped at immutable MAX_SUPPLY (10M) and rejects to=0 (H-4 inflation closed); Ownable2Step + renounce disabled. README documents the single-EOA (deployer=owner=operator=feeRecipient) risk and the recommended multisig/timelock + separate operator key + treasury feeRecipient. UNCOMPILED. Note: deployed bytecode unchanged.
All three contracts switched to Ownable2Step and override renounceOwnership to revert, so a stray renounce/typo cannot brick setOperator/withdraw/rake. UNCOMPILED.

CardPack refunds overpayment in commitPack, enforces an optional on-chain maxSupply (tokens minted + reserved), and withdraw rejects address(0) and never touches funds still owed to open commits (reservedFunds). UNCOMPILED.

The matching client-side change (src/pack-evm.ts + backend reading the manifest instead of Object.values(CARDS) order, plus a drift test) is for the client agent — written to requests/contracts.md. NOT a .mts I can node --check (TypeScript).

Match accounts now close (close = creator) on settle/draw/cancel/expire, and the vault token account is CPI token::close_account'd to the creator, returning all rent. settle_match/SettleOrExpire contexts gained a creator (SystemAccount = match.creator) as the rent destination. cargo check blocked by host linker; unverified.
